messages.speaker: Customer
messages.text: Hi, I saw the white 2022 Tacoma online, is it still there?

messages.speaker: Staff note (internal)
messages.text: Send him to the Shepard Select lot, the Tacoma is there.

messages.speaker: Agent
messages.text: Yes it is available at our Shepard Select lot.

messages.speaker: Staff note (internal)
messages.text: Correction: the Tacoma moved to the CDJR lot this morning, send customers there.

messages.speaker: Customer
messages.text: Great, which address do I go to?

messages.speaker: Customer
messages.text: Can I test drive the blue Civic on Saturday at 10am?

messages.speaker: Agent
messages.text: Booked: Saturday at 10am for the blue Civic test drive.

messages.speaker: Customer
messages.text: Something came up, please cancel Saturday, I will write again next week.

messages.speaker: Agent
messages.text: No problem, I cancelled Saturday's test drive.

messages.speaker: Customer
messages.text: Thanks

name: old promise survives a long conversation
title: Synthetic - F-150 purchase

messages.speaker: Customer
messages.text: If I buy the F-150 this month do I get anything extra?

messages.speaker: Salesperson Ana
messages.text: Yes, I promise you a free oil change and a full tank with the purchase.

messages.speaker: Customer
messages.text: What colors do you have?

messages.speaker: Agent
messages.text: Black, silver and red.

messages.speaker: Customer
messages.text: Is financing available for 60 months?

messages.speaker: Agent
messages.text: Yes, 60 months is available subject to credit approval.

messages.speaker: Customer
messages.text: I will take the red one, when can I pick it up?

messages.speaker: Agent
messages.text: Paperwork is ready Monday, I will confirm the pickup time tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Customer
messages.text: Where are you located and are you open Sundays?

messages.speaker: Agent
messages.text: We are at 165 New County Rd, Thomaston. We are closed on Sundays.

messages.speaker: Customer
messages.text: Ok, I am just looking for now.
